about_the_game:
In a world plagued by the Demon Lord’s shadow, your village is destroyed, and your little sister is cursed. Fueled by a desire to rebuild what was lost and protect those you care about, you embark on a journey with your childhood friends and a determined guild leader. Together, you’ll face dangerous foes, forge deep bonds, and uncover the truth behind the darkness threatening your world.

Balance thrilling adventures with heartfelt moments as you battle monsters, explore dungeons, and grow closer to six unique heroines. Your choices shape the story, deepening relationships and unlocking romantic paths. Experience a vibrant fantasy world brought to life with stunning hand-drawn monochrome art and a blend of adventure and dating sim mechanics.

Hand-Drawn Manga Aesthetic

Immerse yourself in a beautifully hand-drawn world inspired by classic manga! Though it may be monochrome, the expressive art style brings the characters and their emotions to life, making every moment feel like a panel from your favorite series.

Deep & Dynamic Character Interactions

Every character has their own unique story and dreams. Spend time with them, build relationships, and uncover their hidden pasts. Your choices shape their journey—and yours.

Challenging Yet Immersive Combat

The battlefield isn’t fair, and neither is life! As the protagonist, you start off weak, relying on your powerful allies to survive. But as the story unfolds, you’ll gradually grow stronger—until the day you surpass even your mightiest companions. Experience a turn-based combat system that evolves alongside your character’s journey.

A Story-Driven Experience with Secrets to Uncover

This game is filled with deep lore, unexpected twists, and hidden secrets waiting to be revealed. Will you uncover the truth behind the world and your companions? Every choice you make could lead to a new discovery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 8/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 11/10/8
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
